scenes.basis: 6:1 "He came into his own country" and taught in its synagogue - "Isn't this the carpenter?" (6:3); his country is Nazareth (1:9)
6:7-13 the sending of the twelve from unnamed villages (6:6 "He went around the villages teaching")
6:14-29 Herod's court and the prison where John is beheaded; no place named
6:32 "They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves" - the place is unnamed (Bethsaida, 6:45, is only the boat's destination)
6:45 "to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida"; 6:47 "the boat was in the middle of the sea"; 6:48 "walking on the sea"
6:53 "When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore"
